'''Bubbit''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Droppit]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Tideon]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Bubbit has learned to properly set boundaries. Amid the lovely mist, the smile remains perfectly polite. The eyes, however, tell a different story."

Bubbit is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A stubby, quadruped, blue and white sea slug-like creature with hair and rabbit-like ears that have orange circle markings. It has black eyes with lashes and blue highlights, and it wears a small, fancy bowtie.

Droppit's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with orange, and orange with green.

==Evolution Trial==
Bubbit's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Tideon]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Bubbit to increase stats 3 times
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use x2000 fishing rods) or [[Marathon Party]] (use x2000 skateboards)

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "'This critter proved more intelligent than any animal. Now I have other plans...' -[[NPCs#Dr. C|Dr. C]]'s Log"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Bubbit resembles a rabbit more and more... But isn't there supposed to be a slug somewhere... Where did we go wrong?"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026, its bio description said: "The hairstyle is the part Bubbit takes the greatest pride in, spending a long time grooming each day. Releases a cloud mist when complimented on it."
